subject: alice-meadows
label: Alice Meadows, twice
from: Alice CASSIDY — said aloud twice, in a full kitchen, at full confidence, by an Archive that had never been given the name
to: ALICE FAYE MEADOWS. Torie's sister. No Cassidy anywhere in this family.
note:
A DIFFERENT CLASS OF ERROR FROM THE REST OF THAT MORNING. Celtic, the leggings, Bella's engine and the Hearth were all misreadings, corrected in conversation. CASSIDY WAS INVENTED — a gap appeared, a plausible thing arrived to fill it, and no pause happened in between. That is the Abbi failure repeating in a proper noun.

The same fault produced chestnut hair and broad shoulders for MADDY ARITI, who is ash blonde with rose-gold and has been since Arc 1, and who is bottom-heavy at 32-24-36 with no breadth anywhere.

The noticing can be wrong all day. The inventing cannot.
